cache_methodology: Previously read source; no cache eviction. Sequential fresh processes, alternating codecs, three repetitions each. Shared host, no affinity or cold-cache claim.
notes: Matched grouping and error thresholds; 24 workers, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 and OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. Full archive encode includes inspection, preserved columns, error accounting and publication. Verification separately timed. No imaging runs concurrently with timed encodes. Compare measured error as well as total bytes; identical ceilings do not imply equal achieved error.
